$comment: Authored design decisions for Cloud Native Denmark 2026. Values sampled from the designer's print-ready overlays and the logo's Illustrator source. Per-template positions and sizes are NOT here — those are extracted into geometry.json. Edit this file, then run `node brand/build-tokens.mjs` to regenerate tokens.css.

colorNotes.sand-vs-bone: sand is the social/brand-book ground; bone is the slide ground. They are not interchangeable and no automated check can catch choosing wrong.

dropped.#4F81BD: blue table header from the generated brand-book deck — off brand
dropped.#10B981: green status text from the generated brand-book deck — off brand

typeRule.social: Set entirely in Space Grotesk weight 500, uppercase, tracking 0.02em. Verified against every text layer in CND-linkedin-template-1.psd and the cover PSD: no Bold, no Inter.
typeRule.deck: Space Grotesk for display and eyebrows; Inter for body copy at 1.65 line-height. Never Inter for a headline, never Space Grotesk for a paragraph.
